prior_failure: The first frozen 4-GET pilot received three original Census MTIS PDFs with exact NAS-restored bytes, but urllib GET of the official historical index returned HTTP500 and so no PDF values were accepted.
transport: One curl HTTP/1.1 GET of the same exact index URL, fixed browser-like user agent, 20-second maximum, no retry. Preserve exact body, response headers, error, UTC times and hashes even on failure. Do not re-fetch any PDF. If the index returns HTTP200 and exact links to all three frozen PDFs, use only the prior saved PDF bytes to parse printed release date/time and Table1 adjusted Manufacturers current preliminary and prior revised inventory/sales ratio. Map only first Qlib US session strictly after printed release date; 09:46 same-day is too early for 10:00 ET release.
stop: If the one index request fails or any exact link is missing, record transport unknown and stop. If an original PDF row/date parse fails, record that precise source-layout gap without alternate file/row/format search. Do not treat2011 current bytes or any server Last-Modified as immutable initial-publication evidence. No full historical panel, factor or SOXX account in this version.
